outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle, then pulls the door outward and downward (frames 90–106, image and left_ego_image). By frame 107 the door is lowered and the oven interior is exposed; it remains open through frame 134 as the gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or displacement of unrelated objects is visibly established.
